visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a bustling urban street in front of a PRADA boutique with a light green latticed exterior and large glass windows. A woman in a black jacket and a man in a dark coat walk past the store entrance. The lighting is bright natural daylight, reflecting off the building's glass surfaces. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) Inside the store, the camera focuses on a product display shelf featuring lipsticks with silver caps arranged in rows on a red-accented background. A person's hand reaches into the frame to pick up a cylindrical silver lipstick tube. The indoor lighting is bright and professional, highlighting the metallic textures of the products. A pink logo box "Tramy崔咪" is visible in the top left corner. (3) A woman with long brown hair and a white t-shirt featuring a Mickey Mouse graphic sits in a well-lit room, holding a black and silver PRADA cushion compact. She smiles and points to her cheek while speaking, her eyes wide and expressive. Behind her, shelves are visible, filled with various designer bags and accessory boxes in a warm, indoor domestic setting. (4) A close-up shot shows the cushion compact being held by the woman's hands, revealing a personalized "T.R" engraving on the silver rim and the triangular PRADA logo on top. She uses her fingers to open the lid, showing the interior mesh and a triangular applicator puff. The camera framing is tight, focusing on the reflective metallic surface and the details of the packaging. (5) The woman applies the foundation to her face using the triangular puff, with the camera showing a close-up of her skin. A circular dashed line graphic appears on screen to highlight a red area on her nose and cheek. The background remains the same blurred indoor shelf. Small white text captions with parentheses appear periodically in the middle of the screen. (6) The woman holds up a blue-colored lipstick in a silver hexagonal case. She swatches it on the back of her hand, then applies it to her lips, looking into the camera as if it were a mirror. Her facial expressions are animated and enthusiastic. The lighting remains bright, casting a soft glow on her face and the product. (7) In a final sequence, the woman holds both the compact and the lipstick near her face, posing with a wink and a smile. She gestures with her hands as if inviting the audience to join her. The frame is filled with her upper body and the products, with the domestic background still visible. Large pink and white text overlays encourage engagement at the end.
